messages:
lee (support): SigmaHealth reporting large spike in 503s on dedicated pool-7 AZ1, customer P0. Observed since 09:12 UTC. Hit SLA window. Can we get immediate ownership?

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Can you paste the last 1h p99 / pool stats + a couple sample request IDs?

lee (support): paste below — sample reqs: sh-9a8b, sh-9a9c. p99 = 2.1s, error rate 12% for pool ded-pool-7 since 09:10. Logs attached in thread.

sara (oncall): quick glance looks like overload + some OOM churn. @raj can you check autoscale/queue behavior and routing fallbacks?

raj (eng-platform): Investigating. Early signal: pool hit max nodes and retries are being routed back to same pool (bad fallback loop). Short-term mitigation: route new requests for SigmaHealth to hosted_small variant and reduce retry attempts. I can flip routing in ~10m.

tanya (infra): Confirmed high mem pressure on GPU nodes 7a/7b; one node showing repeated container restarts. I'll restart the affected VM to clear caches — doing it now. ETA 8-12m.

lee (support): Notifying SigmaHealth we have engs on it and working a workaround.

raj (eng-platform): Quick CLI to apply the emergency fallback (will run now):

```
rictl routes update --customer sigmahealth --policy fallback=hosted_small --max_retries=1 --priority=high
```

I'll also set a short TTL on that policy and open a PR to make a safe permanent fix. PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4721 (will add reviewers).

deploy-bot: Canary rollback requested by @tanya for node pool ded-pool-7. Rollback ID: rb-203456-01. See: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rb-203456-01

lee (support): Customer asked for ETA and whether there's any data loss risk.

sara (oncall): No data loss. Mitigation timeline: fallback flip + node restart expected to reduce 503s within ~10-15m. Post-mitigation we'll monitor 30m before marking as resolved.

raj (eng-platform): Mitigation applied at 09:25 UTC. Monitoring p50/p99 and 503 count. Initial drop in 503s observed. Continuing to watch.

tanya (infra): VM restart completed at 09:28 UTC. Node rejoined, memory pressure down. Logs show fewer OOMs.

lee (support): Told customer: "we applied a temporary routing fallback and restarted an affected node; we're monitoring closely and will follow up in 30m with a writeup." They acknowledged.

raj (eng-platform): Follow-ups immediate: open PR for routing defaults + adjust autoscale threshold for dedicated pools serving SigmaHealth. Will tag @sara and infra on the changes.

sara (oncall): Action items and owners:
- tanya (infra): validate node health and run 1h soak (owner)
- raj (eng-platform): PR for permanent routing/autoscale fix (owner)
- lee (support): continued customer comms + schedule postmortem cadence (owner)
- sara (oncall): doc incident notes and close when SOC checks complete

sara (oncall): assigning post-incident to eng-platform for root-cause analysis. Please ping here when PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
